# Polygonal Mind 100 Avatars — runtime subset

Source: [Polygonal Mind 100Avatars R1 release](https://github.com/PolygonalMind/100Avatars/releases/tag/v22.12.1)

License: CC0, as declared by Polygonal Mind in the official release notes. The models may be used in games and other projects. The full source archive is intentionally not included in this repository; download it from the release link above. GAMVerse keeps only the selected runtime models and thumbnails in this folder.

This folder contains the selected human-like VRM models only. VRM uses the glTF binary container and is loaded by the project's GLTFLoader. Non-human/novelty models and source-pack duplicates were not copied into the runtime folder.
